description: This file contains unit tests for the CookieClearingFilter class in the OpenMRS project. The tests validate the behavior of the filter responsible for managing HTTP cookies, especially session cookies, during various request and session lifecycle scenarios.

classes.name: CookieClearingFilterTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class containing multiple test cases to verify the correct functioning of the CookieClearingFilter, including cookie clearing behavior upon session invalidation, creation, and configuration-driven cookie clearing.

classes.name: SessionInvalidationServlet
classes.description: A nested static class simulating session invalidation for testing purposes.

methods.name: setupRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Initializes runtime properties for the tests by fetching them via TestUtil and setting them in the Context.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, initializing filter and mock request/response/session objects.

methods.name: shouldClearCookiesIfSessionEnded
methods.description: Tests that the filter clears cookies when a session is invalidated.

methods.name: shouldNotClearCookiesIfSessionNotInvalidated
methods.description: Validates that cookies are not cleared if the session remains valid.

methods.name: shouldNotClearCookiesIfNewSessionCreatedButNotInvalidated
methods.description: Ensures cookies are not cleared if a new session is created without invalidation.

methods.name: shouldNotClearCookiesIfNewSessionCreatedAndInvalidatedInOneRequest
methods.description: Checks that cookies are preserved if a new session is created and invalidated within the same request.

methods.name: shouldClearAllConfiguredCookies
methods.description: Verifies that cookies specified in the filter's configuration are cleared during a request.

methods.name: shouldClearAllConfiguredCookiesIgnoringWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that cookie clearing configuration ignores whitespace and tab characters.

methods.name: clearJSessionIdOnLogout
methods.description: Helper method to set the property indicating JSESSIONID should be cleared.

methods.name: createChainThatInvalidatesSession
methods.description: Sets up a filter chain that simulates session invalidation.

methods.name: createSessionWithId
methods.description: Creates a mock session with a specific ID, optionally as a new session.
